headline: DoorDash in Talks to Acquire Instacart
summary: DoorDash is in talks to buy Instacart, according to media reports.
why: Consolidation in food delivery and grocery aggregation reshapes market competition, delivery fees, and logistical scale in the e-commerce sector.

impacts.name: DoorDash
impacts.why: Large corporate acquisitions involve substantial capital outlays and complex operational integration risks.

why_moved: Potential mergers of market leaders in food and grocery delivery alter competitive landscapes and prompt valuation adjustments across the delivery sector.
